diff --git a/django/db/migrations/serializer.py b/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
index 7d226955d5..33722915d2 100644
--- a/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
+++ b/django/db/migrations/serializer.py
@@ -103,6 +103,19 @@ class DeconstructableSerializer(BaseSerializer):
         return self.serialize_deconstructed(*self.value.deconstruct())
 
 
+class DeconstructableInnerClassSerializer(BaseSerializer):
+    """Serialize inner classes that have a deconstruct() method."""
+
+    def serialize(self):
+        path, args, kwargs = self.value.deconstruct()
+        module = self.value.__class__.__module__
+        qualname = self.value.__class__.__qualname__
+        full_path = "%s.%s" % (module, qualname)
+        return DeconstructableSerializer.serialize_deconstructed(
+            full_path, args, kwargs
+        )
+
+
 class DictionarySerializer(BaseSerializer):
     def serialize(self):
         imports = set()
@@ -329,6 +342,11 @@ def serializer_factory(value):
         return TypeSerializer(value)
     # Anything that knows how to deconstruct itself.
     if hasattr(value, 'deconstruct'):
+        # Check if the class is an inner class (its __qualname__ contains a dot
+        # and differs from __name__).
+        if ('.' in value.__class__.__qualname__ and
+                value.__class__.__qualname__ != value.__class__.__name__):
+            return DeconstructableInnerClassSerializer(value)
         return DeconstructableSerializer(value)
     for type_, serializer_cls in Serializer._registry.items():
         if isinstance(value, type_):
diff --git a/django/utils/deconstruct.py b/django/utils/deconstruct.py
index aa952f6b73..41b9f56630 100644
--- a/django/utils/deconstruct.py
+++ b/django/utils/deconstruct.py
@@ -27,10 +27,10 @@ def deconstructible(*args, path=None):
                 module_name, _, name = path.rpartition('.')
             else:
                 module_name = obj.__module__
-                name = obj.__class__.__name__
+                name = obj.__class__.__qualname__
             # Make sure it's actually there and not an inner class
             module = import_module(module_name)
-            if not hasattr(module, name):
+            if not hasattr(module, name.split('.')[0]):
                 raise ValueError(
                     "Could not find object %s in %s.\n"
                     "Please note that you cannot serialize things like inner "
